page.content:
Post-Mushroom War continent of candy, fire, ice, and ruins.

How Land of Ooo connects

  • Series: Adventure Time (series) — The original series is set in the Land of Ooo.
  • Faction: Candy Kingdom — The Candy Kingdom stands in the Land of Ooo.
  • Faction: Ice Kingdom — The Ice Kingdom stands in the Land of Ooo.
  • Faction: Fire Kingdom — The Fire Kingdom stands in the Land of Ooo.
  • Location: Tree Fort — The Tree Fort stands in the Grass Lands of Ooo.
  • Event: Mushroom War — The Mushroom War is what left the world that became Ooo.
  • Character: Lumpy Space Princess — LSP drifts through Ooo between Lumpy Space and the Fort.

What is Land of Ooo?

The Land of Ooo is the colorful continent after the Mushroom War, mapped into kingdoms and wastelands where Finn and Jake adventure.

Key threads lead to Adventure Time (series), Candy Kingdom, Ice Kingdom, Fire Kingdom, Tree Fort and Mushroom War.
